ctx.x: So you get a call from Steve James who works with Duke Ellington. He tells you, he says what?

He said that Duke wanted me to come to Spain to join the band. I said, “Well, you know, Spain. I’m not going to Spain myself.” I just didn’t know what to say. I said, “Where is he going to be? Where is the next engagement?” and it was Frankfurt, Germany. And I said, “Okay, I’ll meet him in Frankfurt” and Norman Grantz was managing the tour because Ella Fitzgerald was there, and it just happened that way.
